title: Go: Rate Limiting Algorithms
description: Implement multiple rate limiting strategies in Go including ticker-based, token bucket, and per-IP limiting with HTTP middleware.

steps.title: Ticker-based rate limiter
steps.description: Create a simple limiter using `time.Ticker` that allows one action per tick. Use `for range ticker.C` to process items at a fixed rate. Print each processed item number using `fmt.Printf("Processed %d\n", i)`.
hints: Stop the ticker with ticker.Stop() to release resources

verification.failureMessage: Print 'Processed N' for at least 3 items.

steps.title: Token bucket algorithm
steps.description: Implement a `TokenBucket` struct with `rate` and `burst` parameters. Use a goroutine that adds tokens up to burst capacity on a ticker. Provide a `Take() bool` method (non-blocking) that removes a token if available. Print token counts using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Token bucket refills at a fixed rate
Burst is the maximum accumulated tokens
Use select with default case for non-blocking take

verification.failureMessage: Print token take success/failure and refill events.

steps.title: Per-IP limiting with map
steps.description: Create an `IPLimiter` struct that maintains a `map[string]*TokenBucket`. The `GetLimiter(ip string)` method returns or creates a bucket for each IP. Periodically clean up stale entries using a ticker. Print per-IP rate status using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Use a cleanup goroutine to remove stale entries
Key is a string formatted as remote IP

verification.failureMessage: Print rate limit status for each IP address.

steps.title: Burst support with context
steps.description: Add `TakeContext(ctx context.Context) error` method to `TokenBucket` that blocks until a token is available or the context is cancelled. Use `time.NewTimer` for the wait duration. Print wait time and result using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Calculate wait duration from next refill time
Use select on ctx.Done() and a token channel

verification.failureMessage: Print wait duration and whether token was acquired.

steps.title: Sliding window counter
steps.description: Implement a sliding window log counter using a slice of timestamps. `Allow() bool` removes timestamps older than the window and checks if the count is below the limit. Print the current request count in the window using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Store timestamps in a slice ordered by time
Trim old entries on each check
len(slice) gives current count in window

verification.failureMessage: Print the current count and whether the request is allowed.

steps.title: HTTP rate limiter middleware
steps.description: Create a `RateLimitMiddleware` that uses the `IPLimiter`. Return `http.StatusTooManyRequests (429)` with a `Retry-After` header when rate limited. Pass allowed requests to the next handler. Print request status using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Extract IP from r.RemoteAddr or r.Header.Get("X-Forwarded-For")
Set Retry-After header to seconds until next token

verification.failureMessage: Print 429 responses and Retry-After header values.
